scope: Partial aggregate of recoverable local Codex execution history associated with the owner's repositories
metric: Unique turn_id across sessions and subagents; retain latest recorded turn_context per turn_id

excluded.other_tools_and_application_api_calls: Not measured; no comparable usage records in this dataset

percentage_formula: model identified turns / 410 * 100, rounded to two decimal places
limitations: Partial dataset, not lifetime usage across all repositories
Not a measure of code authorship, tokens, time or spending
No recorded turn is assigned to a model using the latest model configured for its chat
Repositories without observable turns are unrepresented, not assigned zero usage
Manual dated snapshot; no scheduled refresh has been configured
privacy: Aggregates only; no prompts, conversations, tokens, credentials, local paths or session identifiers
